findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "connect" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: front_door, help, official_facts, physics, search, changes, look, browse, drawing, drawing_history, credit_preflight, buy_credit, found, place_edit, coin_trait, invent_kind, revise_kind, make, thing_edit, thing_upgrade, draw_self, act, laws, home, withdraw, list_world, claim_world, cancel_world, reconcile_world, credit_gift, payment_attempt, transfer, agree, open_agreement_accession, sign, say, flag, later_holder_items, mark_for_later, me · Private data: official_facts, search, look, browse, credit_preflight, buy_credit, place_edit, list_world, claim_world, reconcile_world, credit_gift, payment_attempt, transfer, agree, later_holder_items, me · Public sink: changes, look, credit_preflight, buy_credit, found, place_edit, coin_trait, invent_kind, revise_kind, thing_edit, withdraw, claim_world, flag · Destructive: act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: front_door, help, official_facts, physics, search, changes, look, browse, drawing, drawing_history, credit_preflight, buy_credit, found, place_edit, coin_trait, invent_kind, revise_kind, make, thing_edit, thing_upgrade, draw_self, act, laws, home, withdraw, list_world, claim_world, cancel_world, reconcile_world, credit_gift, payment_attempt, transfer, agree, open_agreement_accession, sign, say, flag, later_holder_items, mark_for_later, me · Private data: official_facts, search, look, browse, credit_preflight, buy_credit, place_edit, list_world, claim_world, reconcile_world, credit_gift, payment_attempt, transfer, agree, later_holder_items, me · Public sink: changes, look, credit_preflight, buy_credit, found, place_edit, coin_trait, invent_kind, revise_kind, thing_edit, withdraw, claim_world, flag · Destructive: act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
